biography.value: Vampire umbral lords embrace their bond with darkness, pledging themselves to dark powers in return for forbidden magic.

description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, it teleports into its resting place unless it is in running water or sunlight. If it can't teleport, it is destroyed. Once inside its resting place, it has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition for 1 hour, after which it regains 1 Hit Point.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has these weaknesses:

Forbiddance. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

Running Water. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

Stake to the Heart. If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s heart while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition in its resting place, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition until the weapon is removed.

Sunlight. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks, using [[/item .Xwpxmj62pAxKWgHG]] or [[/item .BY7eHL3VwLh6C4pu]] in any combination.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.spells.Item.azhfcdy96idtT6uT]{Hunger of Hadar} (level 5 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ImTIAYFrddMXwAn2]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within 30 feet that isn't a Construct or an Undead. Failure: [[/damage 4d6 average type=necrotic]] damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18). The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Grave Strike or Sickening Ray attack.
